text: Why does motion feel backwards? Slide a book across a table, and it stops. But not because motion needs a push. It stops because friction is fighting it!
That is Newton's First Law: Inertia! An object in motion stays in motion unless an unbalanced force acts on it. In deep space, with zero friction, you glide forever without burning any fuel.

Law Two: Force equals mass times acceleration. Acceleration is force divided by mass. Kick a light soccer ball with 50 Newtons, it flies! Kick a heavy boulder with the same force, its mass resists acceleration.

Law Three: Action and Reaction. Every action has an equal, opposite reaction. The secret? They act on different objects! A rocket pushes exhaust gas down; the gas pushes the rocket up. They never cancel out!
The golden rule: Forces do not cause motion. Unbalanced forces cause changes in motion!
Next time you brake in a car and lurch forward, thank inertia! Follow for more physics made simple.
